news.analysis: Vidal didn't see much work for the Chargers on Monday night. He saw just two carries over the course of the night, and the team gave Omarion Hampton 22 carries, which shows their clear mindset shift away from the committee approach that they employed in the backfield for much of the season. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect Vidal to have much relevance for the foreseeable future.
news.contents: Kimani Vidal rushed the ball two times for zero yards and caught two passes for 14 yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.title: Kimani Vidal uninvolved in win Monday

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Kimani Vidal has seen his involvement trend down over the last couple of weeks, and he took another step in the wrong direction with a mere 26% snap share, two carries, and two receptions on Monday against the Baltimore Ravens.
